questions.q: Explain how excess supply in a market leads to a new equilibrium.

ideas.label: Excess supply means unsold goods, so firms cut prices
As price falls, demand extends and supply contracts until they are equal

questions.model: Excess supply means firms have unsold goods, so they cut prices. As the price falls, quantity demanded extends and quantity supplied contracts until the two are equal at the new equilibrium.
questions.why: The price falls, and both sides adjust.

tests.answer: Firms have unsold stock so they cut prices. Quantity demanded extends and supply contracts until they are equal.
